title: Zoom - Service Degradation Affecting Zoom Learning Webpage
text:
Service: Zoom
Incident: Service Degradation Affecting Zoom Learning Webpage
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-21T07:43:51.052-07:00
Resolved: 2026-10-21T09:25:01.265-07:00
Updates:
- 2026-10-21T09:25:01.265-07:00: resolved - This incident has been resolved and the affected service has been restored.
- 2026-10-21T08:08:12.236-07:00: monitoring - A service degradation affecting Zoom Learning Webpage has been successfully resolved.

Our team will continue to monitor the situation closely and keep you informed of any further developments.
- 2026-10-21T07:53:56.853-07:00: identified - We have identified an issue with our external vendor where users are experiencing issues with Zoom Learning Webpage.

We are actively working with our vendor partner to resolve this issue.

We will share updates as soon as they become available.
- 2026-10-21T07:43:51.203-07:00: investigating - We are currently investigating a service degradation affecting Zoom Learning Webpage.

Our team is actively working to identify the impact and root cause. We will provide an update as soon as more information becomes available.

We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this issue.
